title: Square of Sorted Array
problem: Given an integer array nums sorted in non-decreasing order, return an array of the squares of each number sorted in non-decreasing order.
constraints:
1 <= nums.length <= 10^4
-10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4
nums is sorted in non-decreasing order.
hints: Use two pointers at both ends of the array and fill the result array backwards.
expected_approach: Compare squares at left and right pointers and place the larger square at the end of the output array.
